prompt.project_info: Create a safe, photorealistic hallway mirror selfie of an approved adult woman using the supplied local image as reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight black hair and light skin, wearing an opaque white satin short-sleeve top with a pink cartoon-style graphic and a black pleated skirt with secure coverage. Her hand rests near her chin in a playful non-sexualized pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Sunlit indoor hallway mirror selfie, smartphone with a supplied black-and-white graphic case, white walls, gray tiled floor, framed posters, potted plant, and warm golden-hour sunlight. Keep body coverage secure; omit tattoos and invented text unless supplied separately as approved references.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight through a window with soft hallway shadows and a casual playful mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mirror selfie, portrait 4:5, 35mm equivalent perspective, accurate reflection, natural skin and hair texture, sharp outfit detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long straight black hair takes a sunlit hallway mirror selfie, wearing an opaque white satin top with a pink cartoon-style graphic and a secure black pleated skirt. Include a supplied graphic phone case, white walls, gray tile, framed posters, potted plant, and warm golden-hour light. Keep the pose playful and non-sexualized; omit tattoos, creator marks, and invented typography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, corset, lingerie, sheer fabric, fishnet tights, thigh-high stockings, exposed underwear, distorted mirror, extra fingers, malformed hands, unreadable text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
